status_legend.complete_local_synthetic: Working end to end in the approved local synthetic environment: domain service, API, at least one client making real calls, and a test
status_legend.partial_workflow: Reachable but incomplete: missing states, hard-coded inputs, or a synthesised value standing in for real capture
status_legend.backend_only: Domain service and/or API route exist; no client calls them
status_legend.ui_only: A client renders the surface with no API call behind it
status_legend.blocked_production_provider: Complete against the local fake adapter; blocked on a real provider decision
status_legend.gated: Requires a named approval per FEATURES.md; must stay unavailable until it is recorded
status_legend.excluded: Deliberately not part of the product per FEATURES.md

meta.session_note: Reconciled 2026-08-30 against the cross-layer audit: contract paths repaired, dispatch retry added, custody chains linked, admin refund and moderation surfaces rewired. Validated by tooling/scripts/verify-feature-matrix.mjs.
meta.scope_reconciled: 2026-09-06; existing implementation claims are not re-certified; see docs/engineering/phase-conformance-audit.md

evidence_legend.true: Implemented at this layer and named in verified_by by a verifier that exercises it
evidence_legend.partial: Implemented at this layer with a named verifier covering only part of the behaviour
evidence_legend.ui_only: The layer renders the surface with no API call behind it
evidence_legend.unverified: Believed implemented at this layer, but no verifier in this repository demonstrates it. Cannot support a complete_local_synthetic status.

meta.phase_steps_note: phase_steps names the canonical `#### n.n` steps in phases.md that deliver the capability. target_stage is a historical, unrelated numbering and is never a phase number.
meta.verified_by_note: Executable verifiers only: a spec file, a connected database/scripts/verify-* module, or a control script. A design document is not evidence.
